notes.title: Version 0.0.991 Released
notes.notes:
Hey Wolfpack,

Arctic Wolves 0.0.991 is now live! 🛠️

🐺 What’s New:

[list]
[*] 👁️‍🗨️ Improved first-person view
[*] 🚁 Helicopter AI: helicopters now occasionally fly around, including police chase helicopters
[*] 🪂 Fall damage improvements: fixed for players and now applies to vehicles
[*] ⚙️ New option to adjust the UI scale
[*] ⏩ Quick Start option: optionally skip character customization when starting a new game
[*] 💥 Added a new type of explosive
[*] 🧬 New modifiable attributes in the character customization
[*] 🛠️ Bugfixes and more
[/list]

Thanks for playing, enjoy the update! 🐾

notes.title: Version 0.0.99 Released!
notes.notes:
Hey Wolfpack!

Arctic Wolves 0.0.99 is here! 🚀

🐺 What's New:

🌍 Localization: Arctic Wolves now supports multile languages!

Now available in: Chinese, Czech, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Hungarian, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Turkish, and Swedish!

🎮 Improved Controller Support: The game is now fully playable with Xbox controllers.

📍 New Locations: Two new Locations have been added!

🔫 New Weapon: A new Weapon has been added!

🛠 Bug Fixes & Optimizations: Smoother Gameplay, lots of small improvements and helpful additions!

⚙️ Workshop Enhancements: Uploading custom characters is now even easier.

Enjoy! 🎉🐺

notes.title: Version 0.0.982 Released
notes.notes:
Hey Wolfpack!

⚠️Arctic Wolves 0.0.982 is Here! ⚠️

This update fixes a critical bug where HUD elements were missing. It also resolves an issue where players could get stuck in quest dialogues.

Besides of that, you can now download Arctic Wolves on MacOS!

Have fun and stay wild! 🐺🎮

notes.title: Version 0.0.98 Released
notes.notes:
Hey Wolfpack!

🐺 Arctic Wolves 0.0.98  is Here! 🚀

The latest update brings new features, optimizations, and quality-of-life improvements to enhance your experience!

[b] What's New:[/b]

[list]
[*] A new Pause Menu 
[*] Performance Optimizations
[*] New Graphics Settings – Added options for post-processing effects
[*] New Control Bindings Display – Quickly check keybinds in-game
[*] In-Game Stats Screen – Press H / Select to view character stats
[*] Unlock Cheat - Added a cheat to instantly complete all quests and unlock all content
[*]Steam Achievements – Added Steam Achievements
[*]Steam Workshop Integration – Upload and download custom characters and skins
[/list]
Have fun and stay wild! 🐺🎮

notes.title: Join the Arctic Wolves 0.0.98 Testing Team!
notes.notes:
Hey Wolfpack!

Arctic Wolves 0.0.98 will launch soon! This update includes Steam Workshop Integration for sharing your created characters and skins, as well as Steam Achievements.

Before the update goes live, I’ll be releasing it to a group of early testers on Steam.

If you’re interested in trying out the Steam integration and optimizations, you can join the Steam Group here:
👉 https://steamcommunity.com/groups/arctic-wolves-testers


This testing phase is intended to identify any potential new bugs in the game, especially with the Workshop. If you play the new version and encounter any issues, please report them in the Group Discussions:
👉 https://steamcommunity.com/groups/arctic-wolves-testers/discussions


See you soon! 🐺

notes.title: Version 0.0.974 Released
notes.notes:
Hey Wolfpack!

Arctic Wolves version 0.0.974 just got released! 

Here's what's new in the update:

[list]
[*] Bugfixes & general improvements
[*] Helpful Hints: Loading screens now feature gameplay tips
[*] New audio option to disable nsfw sounds
[*] Build-Mode Enhancements:

[list]
[*] New objects have been added
[*] RGB lamp colors can now be customized using the 'Ambiance' option
[/list]
[*] NPC Interaction: Use the 'Interact' dialogue option to direct NPCs to interact with specific objects like chairs
[*] Custom Game Configurations: A new game.ini file is generated in the Custom folder when you start the game. This lets you fine-tune various game settings to suit your preferences
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288928/cc0ed5bba76a00ba645c8d39d5b6409691ba5efe.jpg[/img]

Enjoy the latest features and keep creating your own adventures! 🎮✨

notes.title: Arctic Wolves Launch on Steam 🐺
notes.notes:
Hey Wolfpack!

Exciting news: Arctic Wolves is officially launching on Steam on November 20! 🎉
To all our amazing players who’ve supported the game from the start, thank you - you’re the heart of this community. And to all the new players joining us, welcome to the pack! 🐺

Get ready to dive into the snowy, action-packed world of Arctic Wolves with all the features you love - 
customization, quests, combat, and more - soon available on Steam!

🎮 See you on November 20! 🌟
